gen.title: Compare interest rate and APR for loan shopping

cards.stem: What makes up the APR in addition to the interest rate?
options: The APR is the interest rate plus any additional fees charged by the lender
Only the principal balance
Daily account maintenance charges
Future insurance premiums
cards.quote: The APR is the interest rate plus any additional fees charged by the lender.
cards.hint: Think about what extra lender costs are added to the rate.

cards.stem: How can shoppers reliably compare loan offers from different lenders?
options: Since all lenders must provide the APR
You must compare interest rates to APRs
You should trust the first offer only
You cannot compare any loan prices
cards.quote: Since all lenders must provide the APR, you can use the APR to compare auto loans.
cards.hint: Remember what every lender is required to share for shopping.

cards.stem: When must lenders share key loan terms including the APR?
options: They must provide this info before you finalize your car loan
After the loan is fully repaid
Only if you ask in person
Once a year after closing
cards.quote: They must provide this info before you finalize your car loan.
cards.hint: Consider when disclosure is required in the loan process.

cards.stem: What does an interest rate represent for a borrower?
options: An interest rate is the cost you pay to the lender for borrowing money
The total fees added to the APR
The required down payment amount
The lender profit guarantee
cards.quote: An interest rate is the cost you pay to the lender for borrowing money to finance your loan, on top of the loan amount or your principal.
cards.hint: Focus on the basic price of borrowing apart from fees.
